name: com.arena-predictions/arena
title: Arena Predictions
description: Paper trading for prediction markets. Read live markets and place paper trades from your agent.

environmentVariables.name: ARENA_MCP_ALLOW_TRADE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to register the paper-trade tools (place_trade, sell_trade, get_orders, cancel_order, settle_open). Any other value leaves trading off.

environmentVariables.name: ARENA_CREDENTIALS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a credentials file for headless or CI use. By default the server reads the credentials that `arena login` stored.
